capabilities: Browse a Zotero library in a searchable, sortable table view
Generate and update literature notes from Zotero metadata and PDF annotations
Format highlights and comments using templates, placeholders, colors, and keywords
Sync the library view and notes automatically with the exported Better BibTeX JSON
Open Zotero entries, web links, and local PDFs from the library view
disambiguation: Not just a read-only library browser; it also creates and updates literature notes from Zotero metadata and annotations.
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and "vibe coded" in the README; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; previously known as bibnotes and Zotero Library View (plugin ID is now zotero-lib-view); installable via BRAT.
intentEvidence: This project is a major enhancement of the original bibnotes project by Stefano Pagliari
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse a Zotero reference library or turn its metadata and PDF annotations into literature notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin is a fork of bibnotes by Stefano Pagliari.
importing, updating, and browsing your Zotero library directly inside Obsidian
A dedicated table view that reads your Better BibTeX JSON directly.

requires.name: Zotero with the Better BibTeX plugin

summary: Zotero integration that imports a Better BibTeX JSON library, generates and updates literature notes with annotations, and browses references in a table view.
